name: Razaketh
description: Razaketh is a demon who held a contract on Liliana Vess's soul and ruled over Amonkhet's gate to the afterlife until she killed him.

description_citations.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

summary.text: Razaketh is a demon who held a contract on Liliana Vess's soul and ruled over Amonkhet's gate to the afterlife until she killed him.

citations.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

bio.text: Nicol Bolas brokered Liliana's deal with four demons, and Razaketh was one of the two that remained.

citations.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Liliana learned that Bolas was on Amonkhet, home of Razaketh, and hunted him there, keeping this secret from Jace.

citations.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.
"Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

bio.text: On Amonkhet he was depicted in a mural guarding the gate to the afterlife, and only the Chain Veil kept him from activating her contract.

citations.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.
"Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

bio.text: In the Hour of Revelation a winged demon came through the Gate and spilled his own blood into the Luxa, turning the river to blood, and called out for Liliana.

bio.text: He took control of Liliana's body and toyed with her, but her allies attacked and Jace broke his control over her mind.

citations.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.
"Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

citations.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

bio.text: Nissa later accused Liliana of using the group to free herself by killing Razaketh.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

status.text: Razaketh is dead, devoured by crocodiles raised by Liliana at the Luxa River on Amonkhet.

citations.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.
"Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas brokers Liliana's deal with four demons.
timeline.quote: Bolas then brokered a deal with the four demons who would give Liliana her youth and a fraction of her old power back, in exchange for servitude.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess kills the demon Razaketh.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess kills the demon Razaketh .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana pins Tezzeret under her heel and forces him to reveal Bolas is on Amonkhet, home of the demon Razaketh.
timeline.quote: "Razaketh," he gasped.

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes she must eventually confront Razaketh, one of two remaining demons, and says Amonkhet aloud.
timeline.quote: "Amonkhet," she said aloud. "He's on Amonkhet."

citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana lounges in a shaded tent, served by mummies, thinking of her hunt for Razaketh and of Nicol Bolas, who brokered her demonic contracts.
timeline.quote: Razaketh would make three.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The shade stops at a wall of inscriptions bearing Razaketh's name, which makes Liliana sway.
timeline.quote: The inscription swam in her vision, and whispers pawed at the edges of her awareness.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: At a mural of the afterlife, Liliana and Jace see Razaketh depicted guarding the gate as the final test.
timeline.quote: Beyond the gate, Razaketh. Beyond Razaketh, paradise.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she is hunting Razaketh, and Jace angrily accuses her of breaking the Gatewatch's trust by hiding her demons.
timeline.quote: You broke our trust.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The carving of Razaketh opens its eyes and the mummies whisper Liliana's name, then attack her and Jace.
timeline.quote: The carving of Razaketh . . . opened its eyes.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Jace flee the embalming chamber; Liliana says Razaketh knows she is here and only the Chain Veil stops him activating her contract, and Jace admits Temmet will remember what he saw.
timeline.quote: Chain Veil's the only reason he can't . . . activate my contract.

citation.text: "Servants" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace helps Liliana kill Razaketh.
timeline.quote: he summoned illusions to distract the demon and allowed Liliana to kill the demon.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace accuses Liliana of betraying their trust over Razaketh.
timeline.quote: Learning of her motivations with the demon, Jace accused her of betraying their trust.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Razaketh takes control of Liliana's body.
timeline.quote: Razaketh managed to take control over Liliana's body

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana tears Razaketh apart.
timeline.quote: she tore him apart and let her undead feast on his remains

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A winged demon flies through the Gate and perches on an obelisk, and Samut recognizes it.
timeline.quote: Demons were rare on Amonkhet.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The demon spills its own blood into the Luxa, turning the river to blood and killing the creatures in it.
timeline.quote: The demon had turned the river into blood.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The demon calls out for Liliana Vess, saying she cannot hide.
timeline.quote: I know you are here, Liliana Vess. You cannot hide from me.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana waits at the bloody Luxa and contacts Jace in her mind as Razaketh calls out for her.
timeline.quote: Jace? Can you hear me?

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh scans the crowd and Liliana finds her hand moving involuntarily.
timeline.quote: The movement of her hand had been . . . involuntary.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh spots Liliana and the Gatewatch arrive, bruised from the arena.
timeline.quote: Liliana saw the rest of the Gatewatch arrive.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh commands Liliana to come to him, and her body wades into the river of blood against her will; Chandra and Nissa are repelled by necromantic energy.
timeline.quote: her body waded forward into the river of blood.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana's body swims itself across to the Necropolis bank, where Razaketh stands smugly above her.
timeline.quote: She had crossed the river and crawled onto the opposite bank.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh toys with Liliana, making her kneel, nod and bark, and tells her he has fulfilled a friend's assignment.
timeline.quote: I love a dog who comes when she is called.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana regains her speech and tells Razaketh he has five minutes to live, then counts down to stall until her allies arrive.
timeline.quote: You have five more minutes to live,

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra engulfs Razaketh in fire at Liliana's signal, and he rams her into the Necropolis wall.
timeline.quote: a jet of fire engulfed the demon.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh dislocates Liliana's shoulder and silences her until Nissa's elemental breaks his concentration.
timeline.quote: A massive elemental emerged, its body forming from the banks of the river.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Razaketh stops Liliana's breathing and paralyzes her as Chandra takes aim at him.
timeline.quote: She tried to suck in air, but her diaphragm was completely still.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, camouflaged by Jace, slashes Razaketh's back with his sural, freeing Liliana's breath and shielding her with his invulnerability.
timeline.quote: carving three thick lines in Razaketh's back.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace breaks Razaketh's control over Liliana's mind.
timeline.quote: Got him, move fast,

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises the dead animals of the river against Razaketh and blasts him down.
timeline.quote: a menagerie of death spilled up and out of the river of blood.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana possesses two dozen dead crocodiles and devours Razaketh, killing him.
timeline.quote: her two dozen selves consumed the last of the demon Razaketh.

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The Luxa drains through the opened Gate as the demon's spell unravels old magics.
timeline.quote: all that remained of the mighty Luxa was a few rivulets of red

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch strike down the demon Razaketh, sparing Liliana from using the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: the planeswalkers struck the demon down swiftly, sparing Liliana from resorting to the hated power of the Chain Veil .

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Revelation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa accuses Liliana of running after killing her demon Razaketh and using the group to free herself.
timeline.quote: You got what you wanted and ran.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Hapatra leaves Kefnet to his fate when he will not stand against Razaketh.
timeline.quote: Hapatra was a devoted follower of Kefnet, until she saw that he would not stand up against the demon Razaketh and left him to his fate.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Gate to the Afterlife opens, revealing Razaketh, who turns the Luxa River to blood.
timeline.quote: the Gate to the Afterlife opens, revealing the demon Razaketh

citation.text: "Accounting of Hours", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Hour of Revelation Razaketh was revealed and turned the Luxa to blood.
timeline.quote: At the demon's command, the Luxa turned to blood.

citation.text: "Luxa River", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Razaketh turns the Luxa River into blood, killing most serpents or making them highly aggressive.
timeline.quote: When Razaketh transformed the Luxa into blood, most serpents either died or became highly aggressive .

citation.text: "Serpent", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
